plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Business Administration 2.0 AS-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8047/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-63; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+16+16+14 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 statistics choice ECON 310/STAT C1000E/PSYC 330 -> 3; Sem 4 calculus choice MATH 341/MATH 400/MATH 355/MATH 343 -> 4). STATISTICS CHOICE: ECON 310 Statistics for Business and Economics (3 units), STAT C1000E Introduction to Statistics (4 units), or PSYC 330 Introductory Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences (3 units); all require Intermediate Algebra or equivalent (placement; documented here, not encoded). Lower bound 3 encoded. CALCULUS CHOICE: MATH 341 Calculus for Business and Economics (4 units; requires Intermediate Algebra or equivalent), MATH 400 Calculus I (5 units; requires MATH 370 or MATH 372 AND Math 373), MATH 355 Calculus for Biology and Medicine I (4 units; requires MATH 335), or MATH 343 Modern Business Mathematics (4 units; requires Intermediate Algebra or equivalent). Lower bound 4 encoded. Option-specific prerequisites documented here, not encoded on the choice slots. ACCT 301 advisory per map: ACCT 101, BUS 105, MATH 120 or MATH 125 (recommendation only; documented here, not encoded). ECON C2002 and ECON C2001 require Intermediate Algebra or equivalent (placement; documented here, not encoded). Semester 1 Area 4 footnote: a total of 6 units from 2 disciplines is required for CalGETC Area 4; select something other than ECON (ECON C2002 in Semester 2 carries Area 4). Semester 3 'CalGETC Area 1A - Oral Communication' row carries GE AREA 1C (typo; encoded 1C). Semester 4 'CalGETC Area 5A - Biological Sciences' row carries GE AREA 5B (typo; encoded 5B). Each CSU may have slightly different transfer requirements; work with a counselor on the academic plan.
